title: Regular expressions
targetPerformance: Solve at least 9 of 10 JavaScript regex tasks in 25 minutes: whole-string validation, captures, lookarounds, and extracting fields from a supplied log line.
whyItMatters: Turn text cleanup and log inspection into short, checkable experiments.

subskills.title: Choose character classes
subskills.why: Specify allowed characters without matching unrelated text.
subskills.selfCorrection: Test one allowed character, one forbidden character, and the empty string.
drills: Contrast a class with its negation.

subskills.title: Anchor matches
subskills.why: Distinguish a full value from a matching substring.
subskills.selfCorrection: Try a valid value embedded inside extra characters.
drills: Compare line anchors with the m flag.

subskills.title: Control repetition
subskills.why: Set lengths and avoid greedy overmatching.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check zero, minimum, maximum, and one-past-maximum lengths.

subskills.title: Capture useful fields
subskills.why: Return the desired fields while keeping structural groups non-capturing.
subskills.selfCorrection: Number capturing parentheses from the left and inspect match groups.

subskills.title: Choose alternatives
subskills.why: Scope OR correctly and protect whole-string constraints.
subskills.selfCorrection: Try each branch plus a prefixed or suffixed near miss.

subskills.title: Assert context
subskills.why: Require surrounding text without consuming it.
subskills.selfCorrection: Inspect the matched text itself, not just whether a match exists.

subskills.title: Parse a log line
subskills.why: Extract timestamps, levels, IP-shaped tokens, and key=value fields.
subskills.selfCorrection: Compare every captured field with the original line and reject malformed examples.

resources.title: MDN RegExp reference
resources.why: Check match APIs and RegExp behavior.
